comments.author: Rashid
comments.body:
server time is GMT, which is 4 hours ahead of east coast USA time.
but the thing with liners is they are always leaving one end of their line at the top of each hour.
so if you are at port 5 mins till and the liner is not there, then it will be at the next hour.

comments.body: 'ey, there are now two new liners to San Francisco in Lima and Panama! Since you can log out in a liner after boarding it and log back in at your destination (after it's left and reached that destination, of course!), that's handy if you have to stop the game for any reason in those cities, but don't mind paying for a quick shortcut between them.
